{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Herb Sauté Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Herb Sauté Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= |uses= Restoring [[Heart]]s |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Herb Sautés''' are recurring [[Item]]s and [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Herb Sauté|Herb Sautés|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} }} |- | ''No name is given'' | {{AoI}} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Herb Sautés are dishes made by [[Cooking]] any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] together with [[Goron Spice]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their neutral versions are made by using [[Hyrule Herb]]s, which offer no status effects. When eaten, they will replenish some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. Herb Sautés are fragrant mixtures of herbs and spices that have a unique aroma. Different variations of Herb Sautés can be made, depending on the type of [[Ingredient]]s used: * '''Chilly Herb Sauté''': Made by using [[Cool Safflina]]s. Eating them grants Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Herb Sauté''': Made by using [[Electric Safflina]]s. If eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]] temporarily. * '''Enduring Herb Sauté''': Made by using [[Endura Carrot]]s. These Sautés completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] when consumed. * '''Hasty Herb Sauté''': Made by using [[Swift Carrot]]s or [[Swift Violet]]s. Link gains a temporary boost to his movement speed when he eats them. * '''Hearty Herb Sauté''': Made by using [[Hearty Radish]]es or [[Big Hearty Radish]]es. Eating one will completely heal all Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Herb Sauté''': Made by using [[Mighty Thistle]]s. They can be eaten to increase the power of Link's attacks. * '''Sneaky Herb Sauté''': Made by using [[Blue Nightshade]]s or [[Silent Princess]]es. When eaten, they increase Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period of time. * '''Spicy Herb Sauté''': Made by using [[Warm Safflina]]s. When eaten, they grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Herb Sauté''': Made by using [[Armoranth]]s. They increase Link's [[Defense]] if he eats them. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Herb Sautés return in {{TotK}}. Due to the addition of [[Stambulb]]s, it is now possible to [[Cooking|Cook]] their energizing variety. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Herb Sauté is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Daruk, the Goron Hero]]". It is made using three [[Warm Safflina]]s and three [[Goron Spice]]s. Through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]", the number of each [[Ingredient]] required can be lowered to two. Preparing an Herb Sauté before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] will increase the timing window for [[Perfect Dodging]] by five percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== During the [[Quest]] "[[The Smell of Victory]]", [[Cadlan]] uses [[Electric Safflina]] and [[Cool Safflina]] to cover up the smell of [[Sludge]]. Our little plan did the trick—n' now things smell as fresh as a nice herb sauté! Not only that, but our friend Cadlan looked ready to train twice as hard after helpin' out!
